description: This Java class provides utility methods for launching activities via command line using the Android ActivityManager ('am') shell command, and executing shell commands. It interacts with Android's Intent system and reads process outputs, serving as a backend utility for debugging or automation tasks within an Android app or development environment.

classes.name: AMControl
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to launch activities in background using the 'am' command and executing shell commands.

methods.name: launchInBackground
methods.description: Constructs an 'am start' command from the given Intent and executes it to launch an activity in the background.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command provided as a string, captures its output (stdout and stderr), logs debug information, and returns the combined output.
